scenes.heading: Example: Interview concepts
scenes.caption: Try Interview concepts on something tiny in Python. One case, one result, one sentence you could say out loud: what you did, and what changed. A huge example hides the idea. A tiny one shows it.

lines: Open Python.
Pick a tiny case that needs “Interview concepts” and nothing else.
Do that one thing. Ignore the rest of Professional inference engineering.
Finish this sentence: “I used Interview concepts to ____.”
If you cannot fill the blank, the case was too big. Shrink it.

scenes.heading: A mistake that wastes the hour
scenes.caption: Watching every scene and then being unable to do a tiny example is the usual failure. Pause on the example for Interview concepts and actually say the result out loud. Recognition is not the same as being able to use Interview concepts.

items: Pause on the example.
Say the result out loud.
If you cannot, replay that scene before the next one.
